html:
Question 12
?

Let f(x,y,z)=xy−ln⁡z. Find the linear approximation of f at the point (1,1,e).

a
f(x,y,z)≈−3+x−y+ze
b
f(x,y,z)≈−3+x−y−2z
c
f(x,y,z)≈−1+x+y−ze
d
f(x,y,z)≈−1−x+y−2z
e
f(x,y,z)≈1−x+y−ze
Submit
